# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait-first dress-up matching game called “Weekend Branch Closet: No Thoughts, Just Fit.” Preserve the source mechanic: a timed queue presents a target outfit made from one of three garment types and one of three colors. The player taps a garment, taps a color, and presses one action button to submit. Correct submissions award 100 points, restore 15 timer percent up to 100, increase difficulty by 0.05, make the requester leave happy, and spawn a new random request. Wrong submissions subtract 20 timer percent. Time drains while the requester waits, and zero time opens a game-over/restart screen.

Reinterpret the mechanic as a cozy satirical office makeover queue inspired by The Office: a plushie-aesthetic main-character mannequin styles coworkers for ridiculous weekend branch meetings. Use fairycore vines, soft desk props, warm break-room runway scenery, request memo bubbles, meme copy such as “main character energy” and “no thoughts head empty,” and mobile-safe one-thumb controls. Use Canvas and DOM only, inline in `index.html`, with catalog-backed fonts/media where used.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Weekend Branch Closet

## Source truth
- The source game is a single-screen timed dress-up matching game rendered with Canvas and controlled by touch/click buttons.
- Objective: read the incoming customer/request bubble, choose one garment type and one color, then press the action button before time expires.
- Protected input model: three garment buttons, three color buttons, one send button, start and restart CTAs.
- Protected scoring: correct match gives +100 score, adds up to +15 time capped at 100, and increases difficulty multiplier by +0.05.
- Protected failure pressure: wrong send subtracts 20 time; time drains only while the requester is waiting; game over occurs when time reaches zero.
- Protected state loop: start screen -> active play -> game-over screen -> restart into active play.

## Remixed public identity
Weekend Branch Closet reinterprets the same mechanics as cozy satirical office-fashion play. The player is the plushie-aesthetic main-character mannequin in a fairycore weekend break-room runway, matching request memos from office coworkers who need outfits before another meeting.

## Safe transformation surfaces
- Title, HUD vocabulary, CTA copy, request bubble language, reaction feedback, background, focal actor form, customer form, particles, colors, fonts, and media.
- Canvas art can change aggressively because collisions/physics are not part of the source mechanic; matching semantics are UI/state based.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb button selection and action confirmation.
- Random target outfit from exactly three type options and three color options.
- Score/time/difficulty values and state transitions listed above.
- The customer enters, waits, leaves on success, and respawns.

## Implementation spine
A single rebuilt `index.html` uses inline CSS, Canvas drawing, DOM controls, catalog-backed fonts/GIF/audio URLs, and no bundled dependencies.
